notes: 1922 vol 1 plate 37, left half, 200 ft to an inch (~1.35 px/ft). Faces are lot lines; thin solid lines inside streets are water pipes, dashed lines sewers; house numbers are printed inside the street next to a face. Names as printed: POWERS, TAPPAN AVE., CASS AVE., HERRON AVE., RUNNYMEADE AVE., SYLVAN AVE., BEEKMAN ... AVE. (other halves use Beekman Street), LLEWELLYN AVE., BORDEN, MILLER, TOWNSEND, WEBER ST., ELMORE ST., DREMAN AVE., DAWSON, ROLL, FOLLETT, RALSTON, CURD AVE., ENOZ ... ALLEY, DIRR, TOZZER, SPAETH ST., PRANG, SULLIVAN, STODDER ... ALLEY, BURGOYNE, CHERRY (CH... at the gutter), GERINGER, GROUB ST., FARADAY / ROAD, FRICKE ROAD, HAWKINS AVE. (west edge, in the page curl), CASPER ST. printed in the bottom-left margin below the neat line (the west-edge street continues south as Casper on 22-34L). TURRILL and DHONAU names read on 37R. No bracketed old names seen. Split or offset streets: Herron has an upper piece (Powers to y~1000) and a lower piece (y~1505 to the strip street); Elmore has a narrow west piece (Tappan-Cass) and the 60 ft east piece (Rolls estate east to Colerain); Follett has a diagonal piece (railroad to Dreman) and a N-S piece (Dreman to the creek) ~95 px further east; Tozzer Alley has a N-S piece (Powers-Stodder) and a diagonal piece (Elmore-Dreman); Townsend continues ENE of Tozzer as Sullivan; Weber jogs ~40 px; Powers jogs at Colerain and the street east of Colerain on its line is unnamed here (?). Unnamed (?): street east of Colerain on Powers' line (probably Powers continued); street east of Borden at y~2152 (1904 Agnes); the strip/creek road from Cass (y~2073) along Mill Creek to Beekman just south of Dreman (house nos 2006, 1857-1866); the narrow lane crossing Beekman at y~4342; Llewellyn's continuation south of y~4130 is unlabelled (house nos 3582, 3569) and is recorded as Llewellyn. Gutter strip (x > ~5550, also on 22-37R): Colerain/Powers, Colerain/?, Cherry/?, Turrill/?, Colerain/Sullivan, Colerain/Burgoyne, Cherry/Burgoyne, Colerain/Stodder, Colerain/Dhonau, Colerain/Elmore, Tozzer/Dreman, Geringer/Ralston, Groub/Ralston; Colerain's lines are crowded with tracks and pipes, so those points are +-15-20 px. Spaeth and Dreman both end at the green R/W line (recorded as ends, no intersection). Railroads, Mill Creek, the green R/W strips and property lines are not recorded.
